checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest -q; uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_shared_extraction.py tests/test_shared_architecture.py tests/test_shared_legacy_characterization.py

checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check src tests; uv run --frozen --no-sync mypy src/

documentation: Add docs/shared-evaluation.md documenting populations, explicit artifacts and consumer policy boundary.

review.reviewer: Fresh native agent integrated_review (read-only; ship verdict)
review.reconciliation: Parent inspected complete task-owned runtime, added tests/fixtures, modified configuration/docs and removed duplicate implementations against Git baselines. Application static-analysis/runtime/test/lockfile pre-existing edits excluded.
